name: Leon
source:
I met him briefly in a dark allweyway on my way home from the mall. He was standing guard for a door with no signs or anything indicating what it was. A young looking girl and an older man came out the door laughing and giggling, playing around with eachother. The guard urged them back in.

[In game description]
